parts.text: I keep the shared picture of the airspace by working with the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones grouping them, and the closures announced by the authorities. The authorities define zones where flying is prohibited and announce closures, which can be planned with a start and end time or sudden ones applying at once. These closures are often amended during the day, such as when an area is widened or an end time moves, and they can come into force while drones of several companies are already in the air.
